page.overview:
What is Here Comes Revenge?

Here Comes Revenge is the ninth track from Metallica's tenth studio album Hardwired...to Self-Destruct. It was written by James Hetfield and Lars Ulrich.

As the title suggests, the song is about getting back at someone, wanting the strong wish for revenge after a serious betrayal. It was inspired by a fan who lost their daughter to a drunk driver. The song looks into the dark attraction and the emptiness that comes with the idea of "an eye for an eye" justice. The lyrics express feelings of anger, sadness, and the confusing lines between what is right and what is wrong.

Little grave I’m grieving, I will mend you Sweet revenge I’m dreaming, I will end you

I’ve been here since dawn of time Countless hatreds built my shrine I was born in anger’s flame He was Abel, I was Cain I am here I’m hell unbound Burn your kingdom to the ground To the ground
